mapper.sql: id, canonical_symbol, symbol, name, market, name_cn, name_hk, name_en, short_name, pinyin_full, pinyin_abbr, exchange, currency, security_type, list_status, data_source, source_updated_at, source_hash, list_date, delisted, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND (canonical_symbol LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_basic ( canonical_symbol, symbol, name, market, name_cn, name_hk, name_en, short_name, pinyin_full, pinyin_abbr, exchange, currency, security_type, list_status, data_source, source_updated_at, source_hash, list_date, delisted ) VALUES ( #{canonicalSymbol}, #{symbol}, #{name}, #{market}, #{nameCn}, #{nameHk}, #{nameEn}, #{shortName}, #{pinyinFull}, #{pinyinAbbr}, #{exchange}, #{currency}, #{securityType}, #{listStatus}, #{dataSource}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, #{sourceHash}, #{listDate}, #{delisted} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE stock_basic
name = #{name}, list_date = #{listDate},
delisted = #{delisted}, list_status = CASE WHEN #{delisted} = TRUE THEN 'DELISTED' WHEN list_status = 'DELISTED' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE list_status END,
WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE stock_basic SET name = #{name}, market = #{market}, symbol = #{symbol}, name_cn = #{nameCn}, name_hk = #{nameHk}, name_en = #{nameEn}, short_name = #{shortName}, pinyin_full = #{pinyinFull}, pinyin_abbr = #{pinyinAbbr}, exchange = #{exchange}, currency = #{currency}, security_type = #{securityType}, list_status = #{listStatus}, data_source = #{dataSource}, source_updated_at = #{sourceUpdatedAt}, source_hash = #{sourceHash}, list_date = #{listDate}, delisted = #{delisted} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE stock_basic
name_cn = CASE WHEN name_cn IS NULL OR TRIM(name_cn) = '' THEN #{nameCn} ELSE name_cn END,
name_hk = CASE WHEN name_hk IS NULL OR TRIM(name_hk) = '' THEN #{nameHk} ELSE name_hk END,
name_en = CASE WHEN name_en IS NULL OR TRIM(name_en) = '' THEN #{nameEn} ELSE name_en END,
exchange = CASE WHEN exchange IS NULL OR TRIM(exchange) = '' THEN #{exchange} ELSE exchange END,
currency = CASE WHEN currency IS NULL OR TRIM(currency) = '' THEN #{currency} ELSE currency END,
WHERE canonical_symbol = #{canonicalSymbol} AND (
OR (name_cn IS NULL OR TRIM(name_cn) = '') OR (name_hk IS NULL OR TRIM(name_hk) = '') OR (name_en IS NULL OR TRIM(name_en) = '') OR (exchange IS NULL OR TRIM(exchange) = '') OR (currency IS NULL OR TRIM(currency) = '')
)
